about: The vocabulary of reasons for choosing a play. Claude tags each explained play with these codes (catalog/annotations.jsonl). 'factors' names the lab/features.js factors a code corresponds to, where one exists; a code with no factor is something the model can't measure yet. New codes start as 'proposed' and become 'adopted' only when the player agrees.

reasons.name: Play home
reasons.definition: Send a card to its foundation (h): full contribution to progressive play.

reasons.name: Start a home pile
reasons.definition: Play an Ace home, starting its suit's pile.

reasons.name: Open a column
reasons.definition: Empty a column so the high card (or a run it heads) can move there.

reasons.name: Set up a play
reasons.definition: Make a play available that wasn't (e.g. A♠h sets up 4♥a).

reasons.name: Set up a reveal
reasons.definition: Make available a play that will turn over a hidden card; which card is unknown, but the reveal is certain.
reasons.source: worked example (Reveals hidden card on b)

reasons.name: Reveal
reasons.definition: Make a previously hidden card visible (turn over a face-down column card).

reasons.name: Promote
reasons.definition: Make a successor active by playing the lead from the waste.

reasons.name: Draw
reasons.definition: Turn the stock to reveal or surface a new lead.

reasons.name: Partial draw
reasons.definition: A turn of the stock with fewer cards than the Draw setting left (2 of 3 = 0.66 of a full draw's potential).

reasons.name: No play
reasons.definition: Turn the stock because no card play is available.

reasons.name: Bury a playable lead
reasons.definition: A regressive draw: a turn of the stock that covers a waste card that could have been played.

reasons.name: Recycle
reasons.definition: Turn the waste back over so a new draw can be shown.

reasons.name: Regressive play
reasons.definition: A play that appears to end or obstruct play from continuing (e.g. an h-c play with no benefit).

reasons.name: Recall
reasons.definition: Knowing that (and/or which) upcoming draw will surface a buried card.
